title: Distinct statuses
statementMd:
List each flight status that occurs.

Expected columns: `status`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT DISTINCT status FROM flights;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
